description: Expected bytes derived by hand from the rule text at rc.5 (RC5-A); the reference engine does not yet produce them, so this vector is listed in tests/conformance/pending.json until RC5-B. Supersedes bnd-0025, whose expanded_blocked_by depended on "the board's own origin" (AGSC-11-15) without stating it, leaving the reader to infer it from each board's iri (Q55d). Each board now carries its origin explicitly. Same case: two nodes export boards with the same cluster slug and the same task slug; a merging client keys tasks by item IRI and boards by Bundle IRI, renames nothing, and expands the local blocked_by slugs of AGSC-10-13 against the board's own origin and never against the merging client's.
